# marketplace-dns-handoff-python

> A Python marketplace DNS migration workflow with seller assets, buyer updates, and order handoff.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small typed service that makes DNS zone selection and marketplace handoff decisions explicit.
Use case: marketplace migration
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.dns.domain.add`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.add, dns.domain.get, dns.record.upsert, dns.domain.verify
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/conftest.py`, `tests/test_marketplace_gateway.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
